name: SEO Studio
description: Previews meta tags across major search engines and social platforms.
project_description:
SEO Studio provides webmasters with a real-time preview of how a page's meta tags will appear across major search engines and social media platforms. 

 The module adds a new "SEO" tab to Drupal nodes, allowing for quick and easy preview without altering your existing setup.

 Built as a layer on top of the widely used Metatag module, SEO Studio enhances your SEO management greatly, without compromising on technical structure. It’s backwards compatible with Drupal 8 and 9, optimized for multilingual websites and supports both the Claro and Gin admin themes.

 Back to top 

 How to Use 
 After installing and configuring the SEO Studio module via /admin/config/search/flaregpt/metatags , navigate to any node page where you wish to preview the meta tags. You can access the SEO preview by clicking on the "SEO" tab next to the "Edit" and "Delete" tabs or by visiting the URL format /node/{node}/seo .

 The preview will display how your content appears across various social platforms like Facebook and Twitter, as well as search engines. It also includes a "Raw metatags" fieldset, which shows the actual meta tag code the node has.
